name: Design
summary: React component that turns URLs into interactive 3D tree or city artwork that becomes a scannable QR code.
description: Design is the open-source home of an app for interactive visual tools and reusable React components. DesignQR renders a draggable 3D model — four seasonal tree presets or Japanese city miniatures (Shibuya, Dōtonbori, Tokyo Tower) — that transitions into a scannable 2D QR code. React 18.2+ component with logo, details card, zoom, custom themes, PNG export, ref API and reduced-motion support.
contains: DesignQR React component (npm designqr) for React 18.2+ and WebGL
3D tree in spring/summer/autumn/winter; city art for Shibuya, Dōtonbori, Tokyo Tower
drag to rotate, tap or Enter/Space to toggle artwork and QR views
props for logo, details card, zoom, custom themes and controlled view
PNG export, ref API, keyboard access and reduced-motion support
web tool at design.johnson7543.com; MIT licensed
